title: Very effective for underground nests
review: This is fantastic and the only thing that sorted an underground wasps nest. It was underneath a storage unit where we keep the lawnmower, so couldn't get the mower out without being attacked. By morning there was a pile of wasps outside and the nest was no longer active. The wasps had been taking the powder into the nest on their bodies and wings and it killed the entire nest overnight. Highly recommended . It would not work for nests that are high up as you have to get up very close. And don't use when it's windy.
